title: Three Siblings, Bungalow Garden Trellis - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait capturing three young children—likely siblings—posed together in front of a residential wooden cottage or bungalow. The girl on the left wears a light-toned matching outfit accented by a soft beret with a pom-pom, while the younger girl in the center wears a light summer frock with ruffled shoulders and strap shoes. The boy on the right poses relaxed with his hands in the pockets of his high-waisted, wide-leg trousers and a warm knit sweater. Dense flowering vines climb up a trellis behind them beneath the exposed eaves of the home, evoking mid-20th-century suburban or small-town American childhood.
